{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "ring_branch_polarity_partition",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_rich_hydrophobic_surface",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758, effect 9.94); fused ring carbon adds poorly hydrated nonpolar surface."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_high_polarity_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Donor-to-heteroatom role maps hydrogen bonding capacity; polar contacts retain water solvation and lower logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "branch_flexibility_penalty",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.22,
          "rationale": "Rotatable-bond role (weight 0.758): flexible branching exposes polar groups and costs conformational entropy on octanol transfer."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_low_hydrocarbon_baseline",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Heteroatom-sparse scaffolds approach pure hydrocarbon, the classic high-logP extreme of drug-like chemical space."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.2,
      "prior_scale": 0.32,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.2,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "hypothesis": "Retains the higher-scoring generation-1 skill built on the two strongest transfer roles (ring and branch, weight 0.758) plus heteroatom polarity; fails if ring-rich molecules here are heavily oxygenated or ionizable."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "aromatic_core_length_agnostic",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_pi_surface",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Extended aromatic pi surface is poorly hydrated and strongly favors the octanol phase, raising partition coefficients."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_poor_polar_penalty",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_low"},
          "weight": -0.35,
          "rationale": "Aliphatic, aromatic-poor scaffolds in this pool tend to be polar aliphatic chains with lower octanol-water partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "length_role_downweight",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.12,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: the length role is the least confident transfer (0.22); size effect is retained only weakly, not as a driver."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_substituent_lift",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_mid"},
          "weight": 0.28,
          "rationale": "Halogen substituents add polarizable, weakly hydrated surface; the mid bin (743 molecules) gives usable coverage unlike halogen_high."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.4,
      "prior_scale": 0.28,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.38,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.5,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.1,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.95,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "hypothesis": "Domain-knowledge aromatic and halogen substituent surface drives lipophilicity while explicitly downweighting the uncertain size transfer; fails if aromatic_high molecules in this pool carry dominant polar heterocycles."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "ring_branch_polarity_partition",
  "lesson": "Across two generations the ring/branch/heteroatom skill scored 89.3 mean AUC versus 88.0 for the length-inversion skill, and the earlier generation showed the same ordering direction, but both gaps sit inside the 83-93 per-seed spread, so the ordering is suggestive rather than established. The consistent signal is that broad-coverage bins grounded in the highest transfer weights (ring and branch, 0.758) behave at least as well as the low-confidence length role (0.22), which never separated from noise.",
  "revision_summary": "Promoted the previously non-deployed flexible_ring_balance_partition core to deployment as ring_branch_polarity_partition, since it led on development AUC in generation 1 and rests on the two highest transfer-weight roles with broad bin coverage; the branch penalty was softened slightly to reduce over-shrinkage of a 1183-molecule bin. The counter-hypothesis skill now demotes the low-confidence length role to a near-zero weight instead of using it as a driver, and replaces the sparse halogen_high bin (98 candidates) with halogen_mid (743) so the substituent feature can actually inform the surrogate. Deployment frozen on ring_branch_polarity_partition."
}
